import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    ax1.scatter(data['Sleep Duration'], data['Quality of Sleep'], 
               label=gender, alpha=0.6, s=100)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=15, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sleep_disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(sleep_disorder_counts))
ax3.pie(sleep_disorder_counts.values, labels=sleep_disorder_counts.index, 
        autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
ax3.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Physical Activity vs Stress Level
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Sleep Duration'], s=100, alpha=0.6, cmap='viridis')
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4, label='Sleep Duration')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 5. BMI Category Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax5.barh(bmi_counts.index, bmi_counts.values, color='coral', alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 6. Daily Steps by Occupation
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
occupation_steps = df.groupby('Occupation')['Daily Steps'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
ax6.barh(range(len(occupation_steps)), occupation_steps.values, color='lightgreen', alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_steps)))
ax6.set_yticklabels(occupation_steps.index, fontsize=8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Average Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps by Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 7. Heart Rate Distribution by Gender
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
df.boxplot(column='Heart Rate', by='Gender', ax=ax7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Heart Rate by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.sca(ax7)
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
ax7.get_figure().suptitle('')

# 8. Correlation Heatmap
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            ax=ax8, square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8})
ax8.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
